title: FHFA House Price Index — Quarterly Index with Monthly Tables (March 2027 and 2027Q1), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: two FHFA primaries fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane, independently of the sweep that proposed this id. (2) The published 2026Q2 report (HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes, released 2026-08-25; 517 stream objects located, 511 inflated in-session with node zlib), whose "FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027" appendix page carries the identical row directly beneath the statement "Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data" -- a published document, not a second reading of the same web table. notes: PROPOSED by the fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 initial-research sweep (2026-09-08) and researched the same day; proposals/fhfa-hpi-2027-05-25.from-fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30.json is now shadowed by this canonical file. THE FINDING THAT EARNS THE LEDGER IS A CALENDAR IDENTITY NO SIBLING COULD HAVE SEEN, AND ITS TAPE ANSWER IS THE OPPOSITE OF THE ONE THE CHAIN EXPECTED. The last Tuesday of May is the session AFTER Memorial Day in 60 of 71 years 1990-2060; the exception is exactly the years where Memorial Day falls on May 31, which are 1993, 1999, 2004, 2010, 2021, 2027, 2032, 2038, 2049, 2055 and 2060. So 2027-05-25 is one of only TWO May releases in the 2021-2027 panel (with 2021-05-25) that is not the post-holiday session -- five of the six post-policy May releases, 2022 through 2026, are. That set up the same worry the 11-30 sibling confirmed for blackouts: a control that does not transfer. IT DOES TRANSFER. The post-Memorial-Day session is not a distinct regime on any metric -- 2011+, n=16, smallest p=0.3726 against all other sessions and p=0.1286 against other late-May sessions -- so the May release sample carries over to this date intact, and it too is null (n=6 vs 39 late-May sessions, smallest p=0.4892). A SECOND CONTROL TRAP IS DOCUMENTED FOR THE NEXT LANE, and it is the most useful thing in the ledger. This print sits 4 days before fomc-blackout-start-2027-05-29 (the June 8-9 2027 meeting, the earliest June FOMC in the panel). The five sessions before a blackout start LOOK like a regime -- VIX9D/VIX 0.9097 vs 0.9313, p=0.0142 -- and the entire effect is the control group: it contains blackout sessions, which run 0.9884. Against CLEAR sessions only the reading is 0.9097 vs 0.9041, p=0.4833 (seed-stable 0.4749-0.4836). The p=0.0142 is an artefact, not a finding. THE SIBLING'S EDITION SPLIT IS INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED four days later on a fresh Yahoo fetch: pooled 09:00-bar quiet 3.73 vs 8.59 bps p=0.0193, monthly 2.74 vs 8.59 p=0.0229, QUARTERLY -- this edition's kind -- 6.34 vs 8.59 p=0.4726 and p=0.8943 against late-month Tuesdays. CONTENT: the edition carries 2027Q1 (15/15 positive since 2012, all four all-time negatives in 2008-2011, p=0.6502 vs the other three quarters) and the March 2027 m/m (15/15 since 2012, p=0.0990 -- the closest any reference month comes and still null; the seasonal hypothesis stays closed).
